texto:
Create a photoreal head-and-shoulders casting portrait photograph.

Scene: Plain seamless light grey studio background.

Subject: A man, 28 years old, of Punjabi Indian descent. Casting portrait of one of the members of a string quintet. Expression and posture: calm neutral mouth, eyes fixed on the lens, shoulders squared. Head-and-shoulders framing, cropped from the shoulders up, eye-level camera, looking straight into the lens.

Important Details: Distinct features: short neat black beard, thick eyebrows, short side-parted hair, navy shirt collar. 85mm portrait lens feel from about 1.5 metres, chest-height camera, shallow depth of field. Both eyes in sharp focus. Soft even frontal key light with gentle fill, no hard shadows across the face. Natural faces with real skin texture: visible pores, natural tone variation, no retouching. Natural colour photograph.

Use Case: Casting reference portrait; canonized face master (T1) for later shots. Looks like a real photo.

Constraints: One person only, no text, no watermark, no logo, no retouched plastic skin, not an illustration or 3D render.
